rules: Compare actual archive package metadata to lockfile license declarations and hash included LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE files.
Missing/unknown expressions or absent expected notices block release review; no implicit allowlist expansion.
Keep all upstream copyright/license/NOTICE texts when redistributing package bytes or derived image artifacts.
Review attribution for CC-BY assets/documents and determine whether distributed output includes them.
Before distributing MPL-covered libraries or modified files, provide the corresponding covered source and required notices.
Before distributing LGPL native libraries, satisfy applicable corresponding-source/relinking/notices obligations for the actual image and linking mode.
Source-only exports omit node_modules and proprietary assets; downstream installs retain upstream licenses. This does not approve redistribution of the dependency bundle or image.
The maintainer must separately choose a license for Forge/template original code; dependency declarations cannot supply that permission.
